race.comment: COOINDALAI (6) turned in a much better run last time out when she scored by a nose over 1609m at this track. Tackles a similar assignment and she can go right on with the job. BROOKESSMARTDANCER (3) finished seventh last start, beaten 23 metres at Menangle over 1609m. Expect him to pose a serious challenge. DREAM TO DANCE (1) disappointed last time when tenth over 1609m at Menangle. Can make amends. GUNFIGHTERSGHOST (9) is the best of the rest after finishing fourth over 1609m at this track last time out.
